life.damaged.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.not-slate.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.storage-unreadable.text: Your browser couldn't read its storage just now. Reload and try again.
life.storage-unreadable.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.compressed.text: This life was kept compressed, and this browser can't open it. Try a newer one.
life.compressed.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.no-storage.text: This browser won't let SLATE keep anything, so no life can be kept here. Check that the site is allowed to store data.
life.no-storage.where: the slots screen, when keeping a life fails

life.device-full.text: There isn't room on this device to keep this life, so nothing changed. Free some space, or let go of a life you don't need, then try again.
life.device-full.where: the slots screen, when keeping a life fails

life.device-refused.text: This device wouldn't keep the life just now, so nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
life.device-refused.where: the slots screen, when keeping a life fails

server.unreachable.text: SLATE couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.
server.unreachable.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.no-answer.text: The server didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
server.no-answer.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.refused.text: The server turned that down without saying why. Try again in a moment.
server.refused.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.failed.text: The server couldn't finish that. Try again in a moment.
server.failed.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.signed-out.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.bad-request.text: SLATE sent the server something it couldn't use. Reload and try again.
server.bad-request.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.too-big.text: This life has grown too big for the server to keep.
server.too-big.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.damaged.text: The server couldn't read this life, so it didn't keep it.
server.damaged.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.newer.text: This SLATE is newer than the server, so the server won't keep this life rather than risk damaging it.
server.newer.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.behind.text: The server has a later point in this life than this one, so it kept that. Reload to pick it up.
server.behind.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.other-life.text: Another life is already kept there. Let it go before starting a new one in its place.
server.other-life.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.no-copy.text: The server has no copy of this life to bring back.
server.no-copy.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

weather.model.text: Day to day, the weather here is SLATE's own, drawn around the official averages measured near {place} from {years}.

weather.model-undated.text: Day to day, the weather here is SLATE's own, drawn around the official averages measured near {place}.
weather.model-undated.where: Home, under the weather, where the averages don't say the years they cover

weather.borrowed.text: No averages are published from near here in {country}, so the weather follows those measured near {place}, in {placeCountry}.
weather.borrowed.where: Home, under the weather, where the town's own country publishes none

weather.borrowed-part.text: Not every average is published from near here in {country}, so for those the weather follows the ones measured near {place}, in {placeCountry}.
weather.borrowed-part.where: Home, under the weather, where the town's own country publishes some averages and not others

holidays.unannounced.text: {place} hasn't announced its holidays after {year} yet, so the calendar keeps only those its law fixes.
holidays.unannounced.where: the calendar, on a year past the last a country has announced

holidays.unkept.text: {country}'s public holidays aren't on this calendar, so every day there is kept as an ordinary one.
holidays.unkept.where: the calendar, in a country whose holidays the game doesn't keep

holidays.region-unkept.text: {region}'s own holidays aren't on this calendar yet, so it keeps {country}'s national ones.
holidays.region-unkept.where: the calendar, in a region whose own law's holidays the game hasn't read, where its country's other regions keep theirs

holidays.region-unmoved.text: When a holiday in {region} falls on its weekly day of rest, the day off given in its place isn't on this calendar.
holidays.region-unmoved.where: the calendar, in a region whose holidays are kept but whose rule for one on its weekly day of rest the game hasn't read

prices.unkept.text: What things cost in {country} isn't known to this game yet, so nothing there has a price.
prices.unkept.where: wherever a price is shown, in a country whose prices the game doesn't keep

holidays.local.text: Holidays kept only by a town or a district aren't on this calendar; its country's and its region's are.
holidays.local.where: the calendar, under a town's holidays

passports.unkept.text: What a passport from {country} costs, how long it takes to get and how long it lasts aren't known to this game yet.
passports.unkept.where: Papers, for a citizen of a country whose passports the game doesn't keep

passports.fee-unknown.text: What this costs isn't known to this game yet.
passports.fee-unknown.where: Papers, beside a way to get a passport whose fee the game doesn't know

passports.validity-unknown.text: How long this passport lasts isn't known to this game yet.
passports.validity-unknown.where: Papers, beside a passport whose validity the game doesn't know

passports.time-unknown.text: How long this takes isn't known to this game yet.
passports.time-unknown.where: Papers, beside a way to get a passport whose time the office doesn't publish or the game hasn't read

ids.unkept.text: Whether {country} issues an identity card, and what one costs, aren't known to this game yet.
ids.unkept.where: Papers, for a citizen of a country whose identity documents the game doesn't keep

ids.none.where: Papers, for a citizen of a country that issues none

ids.fee-unknown.text: What this costs isn't known to this game yet.
ids.fee-unknown.where: Papers, beside a way to get an identity document whose fee the game doesn't know

ids.validity-unknown.text: How long this card lasts isn't known to this game yet.
ids.validity-unknown.where: Papers, beside an identity document whose validity the game doesn't know

ids.time-unknown.text: How long this takes isn't known to this game yet.
ids.time-unknown.where: Papers, beside a way to get an identity document whose time the office doesn't publish or the game hasn't read

citizenship.unkept.text: How {country} naturalises, and whether its citizens keep its citizenship when they take another, aren't known to this game yet.
citizenship.unkept.where: Papers, for a country whose citizenship rules the game doesn't keep

citizenship.none.text: {country} doesn't naturalise anyone on residence alone.
citizenship.none.where: Papers, for a country that naturalises no one by residence

citizenship.keep-unknown.text: Whether you'd keep your {country} citizenship isn't known to this game yet.
citizenship.keep-unknown.where: Papers, beside a citizenship whose keeping after a naturalisation the game doesn't know

visits.unkept.text: What {country} asks of a visitor isn't known to this game yet.
visits.unkept.where: Papers and travel, for a destination whose entry rules the game doesn't keep

work.unkept.text: What {country} asks of a performer from abroad isn't known to this game yet.
work.unkept.where: Papers and work, for a country whose rules for foreign workers the game doesn't keep

banks.unkept.text: The banks of {country} aren't known to this game yet.
banks.unkept.where: Money, for a country whose banks the game doesn't keep

ages.unkept.text: What a person may do at what age in {country}, and what their sex changes there, isn't fully known to this game yet.
ages.unkept.where: Papers, for a country whose age of majority, working age or military service the game doesn't know

banks.none.text: {country} has no bank of its own, so no account can be opened there.
banks.none.where: Money, for a place with no bank of its own

cards.fees-unpublished.text: {bank} doesn't publish what its {card} costs to hold, so this game charges nothing for it.
cards.fees-unpublished.where: Money, for a card whose bank publishes no fee to hold it

cards.none.text: No bank in {country} offers a credit card, so none can be taken out there.
cards.none.where: Money, for a place where no bank offers a credit card

cards.unkept.text: The credit cards of {country} aren't known to this game yet.
cards.unkept.where: Money, for a country whose credit cards the game doesn't keep

credit.unkept.text: The credit records of {country} aren't known to this game yet.
credit.unkept.where: Money, for a country whose credit records the game doesn't keep

credit.none.text: No bureau in {country} keeps a record of anyone's credit, so a late payment there leaves no mark.
credit.none.where: Money, for a country where no bureau or registry keeps a person's record of credit

rates.unkept.text: What {country}'s money is worth in other currencies isn't known to this game yet.
rates.unkept.where: Money, for a country whose currency's exchange rate the game doesn't keep

means.unkept.text: What a family in {country} has to give isn't known to this game yet.
means.unkept.where: Background, for a country whose families' means the game doesn't know

numbers.unkept.text: What number {country} gives its people, and who needs one, aren't known to this game yet.
numbers.unkept.where: Papers, for a citizen of a country whose national number the game doesn't keep

numbers.none.text: {country} gives its people no national number.
numbers.none.where: Papers, for a citizen of a country that gives none

residence.unkept.text: How someone from abroad can come to live in {country} isn't known to this game yet.
residence.unkept.where: Papers, for a country whose residence routes the game doesn't keep

residence.none.text: No one from abroad can settle in {country}.
residence.none.where: Papers, for a place where no one from abroad may come to live by any route

licence.unkept.text: What a driving licence or an identity card from {place} costs, and who can get one, aren't known to this game yet.
licence.unkept.where: Papers, for a place whose licensing office's licence and card the game doesn't keep

licence.none.text: {place} issues no driving licence of its own: drivers there hold one from elsewhere.
licence.none.where: Papers, for a place that issues no driving licence of its own

account.returned.text: {bank} turned down a payment of {amount}: there wasn't enough in the account.
account.returned.where: Money, when a payment from an account is refused for want of funds

formats.unkept.text: How banks in {country} number their accounts isn't known to this game yet.
formats.unkept.where: Money, for a country whose account numbers the game doesn't keep

cards.minimum-unpublished.text: {bank} doesn't publish the least its {card} asks each month, so this game asks the whole balance.
cards.minimum-unpublished.where: Money, for a card whose bank publishes no minimum payment

means.savings-unkept.text: What a family in {country} keeps in the bank isn't known to this game yet, so it gives nothing in savings.
means.savings-unkept.where: Money, on the first morning, for a country whose household survey publishes no deposits by wealth

work.model.text: How well a script turns out, and how fast a writer improves, is SLATE's own reckoning from the writer's attributes; each reader grades by its own published criteria.
work.model.where: Work, beside a script's scores and a reader's grades

directing.model.text: How well a film turns out, and how fast a director improves, is SLATE's own reckoning from the director's attributes; the guild's terms and each festival's odds are the real ones.
directing.model.where: Work, beside a film's parts and a festival's answer

acting.model.text: How often an audition books, how an actor's skills add up to a performance, and how the ages and languages of parts are spread beyond the published counts are SLATE's own reckoning: no union or casting body publishes them. The pay is the union's minimum.
acting.model.where: Work, beside an audition's result and a part's pay

producing.model.text: How well a producer reads a script, plans a shoot and wins the money is SLATE's own reckoning from the producer's attributes; the funders' terms and the odds of a release are the real ones.
producing.model.where: Work, beside a project's plan, its money and its release

identity.model.text: Which languages are suggested for where you were born and grew up, the ages you can play, and what a family in the business brings you are SLATE's own reckoning from published counts; the languages' shares are Unicode's.
identity.model.where: Identity and Background, beside the suggested languages, the playing age and the family's trade

unions.model.text: Some of what a union asks is SLATE's own reading of its rules against your work: which films count toward SAG-AFTRA, what counts as three years' experience, and how a sale earns a guild's units. The fees and dues are the unions' own.
unions.model.where: Work, beside a union's terms and a card

genres.model.text: Your work is in the genres you love, and how each genre is grouped against the UK's box office is SLATE's own reading; the takings by genre are the BFI's.
genres.model.where: Genres, beside the genres chosen; Work, beside a film's release

permits.unkept.text: Some of what {country} asks of a performer from abroad for a work permit isn't known to this game yet: {missing}.
permits.unkept.where: Papers and work, for a country whose work permit the game knows only in part or not at all

permits.model.text: Some of what a work permit asks is SLATE's own reading of the rules against your life: who applies, which fees are asked, and what counts as distinction, proficiency or age. The fees, the waits and the terms are the governments' own.
permits.model.where: Papers and work, beside a permit's application and its decision

acting.unkept.text: Some of what a performer is paid or asked in {country} isn't known to this game yet: {missing}.
acting.unkept.where: Work, beside a part in a market whose terms the game knows only in part
